$Comment: One of Bram's plain errands, on his own board (Christmas_Shepherd_Jobs): chop logs from any tree.
BREAK_BLOCK counts each trunk block broken: CONTAINS on _Trunk takes every tree's trunk (fir, oak, birch
and the rest), and the library never counts a block the player placed.
Christmas_Errand_Wheat.json explains the board, the slot that posts it only where MMO Skill Tree is
missing, and the pay, which is the same here: Christmas Coins, favor on Santa's Nice List and Festival
Favor. Its Mmo_Xp row (Woodcutting XP) pays nothing with this pack's boards, as that file explains.
